heading: Monday, July 28, 2025
topLine: Harmonic's Aristotle produces Lean-verified solutions to five IMO 2025 problems. Also: Z.ai releases open-weight GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air.

items.headline: Harmonic's Aristotle produces Lean-verified solutions to five IMO 2025 problems
items.summary: Harmonic said its Aristotle system reached gold-medal-level performance on IMO 2025 problems, with formal Lean 4 proofs for five of the six problems, published on GitHub. Its paper says humans translated the problem statements into Lean by hand. The proofs are machine-checked, but the result was not officially graded by the IMO.

items.headline: Z.ai releases open-weight GLM-4.5 and GLM-4.5-Air
items.summary: GLM-4.5 (355B total, 32B active parameters) and GLM-4.5-Air (106B total, 12B active) are MIT-licensed hybrid reasoning models with thinking and non-thinking modes, aimed at reasoning, coding and agent tasks. Z.ai reports GLM-4.5 ranked third across 12 benchmarks behind o3 and Grok 4.
